tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground (source `--bg`). Every section sits on it. Lumindra deep forest; the other three brands are near-black so their neon and gold marks glow.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Alternate band behind a full-width section (source `--bg2`).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Solid card fill for testimonial cards and anything that must read as an object (source `--card`).

tokens.name: nav-glass
tokens.usage: Sticky nav background, always with a 14px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and primary text on `surface`, `surface-2`, `surface-raised` (source `--text`). 13:1 or better in every brand.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Body paragraphs, list items, nav links, captions on any surface (source `--muted`). Lowest pair is 7.4:1.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The brand's signature hue (source `--gold`): card titles, eyebrows, prices, stars, link underlines, the primary button's start colour. Reads as text on every surface (Sunshooters lowest at 4.8:1 on `surface-raised`).

tokens.name: brand-bright
tokens.usage: Lighter step of `brand` (source `--accent`): end of the primary button gradient, emphasised words inside testimonials, hover states.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `brand` or `brand-bright` fill (primary buttons). Always the dark ground, never white.

tokens.name: accent-2
tokens.usage: Secondary glow taken from each logo: Lumindra's tree-of-life spark, the Sunshooters globe, the Conscious Systems teal thread, the Bali AI circuit core. Use sparingly: a status dot, one highlighted word, a chart series. Never for body copy.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Default 1px border on cards, nav bottom edge, footer top, tier chips (source `--line`).

tokens.name: hairline-faint
tokens.usage: Section dividers (`section { border-top }`) and timeline row rules.

tokens.name: hairline-strong
tokens.usage: Border of eyebrows, offer tags, the CTA box and the highlighted quote. Secondary buttons use it at slightly higher strength.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Translucent fill for panels, FAQ items, stat tiles, secondary buttons. The site's main way of separating objects; it replaces shadows on most blocks.

tokens.name: brand-tint-strong
tokens.usage: Hover fill for secondary buttons; top stop of highlight and testimonial-banner gradients.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with 3px offset on every interactive element. Over 4:1 on every surface in every brand.

tokens.name: house-lumindra-green
tokens.usage: Fixed across themes. Lumindra's forest green for portfolio grids and brand pickers that show the whole family at once.

tokens.name: house-lumindra-gold
tokens.usage: Fixed across themes. Lumindra gold, the umbrella brand's colour in family views. Also the PWA `theme_color`.

tokens.name: house-sunshooters-blue
tokens.usage: Fixed across themes. Sunshooters neon-sign blue for family views and fills. As text on black it is 4.2:1, so text uses the theme's `brand` instead.

tokens.name: house-conscious-teal
tokens.usage: Fixed across themes. Deep teal from the Conscious Systems monogram field. A fill only; pair with `house-conscious-gold` for text on it.

tokens.name: house-conscious-gold
tokens.usage: Fixed across themes. Conscious Systems monogram gold.

tokens.name: house-bali-ai-teal
tokens.usage: Fixed across themes. Bali AI Consultant line-art teal for family views.
